rca of the issue: Root cause for iteration_2's two HIGH bugs: FastAPI's default RequestValidationError handler returns 422, but the project's standard contract (DI-0034) mandates HTTP 400 for body validation failures alongside the safe envelope {success:false, errors:[{code:'VALIDATION_ERROR',field,...}]}. The custom handler in safe_errors.py built the correct envelope but returned status_code=422. Fix: change status_code=422 → status_code=400. Mitigation: contract-test (already in test_sprint01_backend.py) now asserts both status code AND envelope shape together, preventing future drift.
